commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "=== STEP 1: install cryptsetup ==="
sudo -n dnf install -y cryptsetup >/tmp/dnf.log 2>&1 || (tail -50 /tmp/dnf.log; exit 1)
rpm -q cryptsetup

echo "=== STEP 2: create backing file for encrypted volume ==="
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/secure-volume
if [ ! -f /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img ]; then
  sudo -n fallocate -l 512M /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
fi
sudo -n chmod 600 /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
ls -la /var/lib/secure-volume/

echo "=== STEP 3: generate root-only keyfile ==="
if [ ! -f /etc/secure-volume.key ]; then
  sudo -n sh -c 'openssl rand -out /etc/secure-volume.key 64'
fi
sudo -n chmod 600 /etc/secure-volume.key
sudo -n chown root:root /etc/secure-volume.key
sudo -n ls -la /etc/secure-volume.key

echo "=== STEP 4: attach loop device ==="
LOOPDEV=$(sudo -n losetup -j /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img | cut -d: -f1)
if [ -z "$LOOPDEV" ]; then
  LOOPDEV=$(sudo -n losetup -f --show /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img)
fi
echo "loop device: $LOOPDEV"

echo "=== STEP 5: luksFormat (idempotent) ==="
if ! sudo -n cryptsetup isLuks "$LOOPDEV"; then
  sudo -n cryptsetup luksFormat --batch-mode --type luks2 "$LOOPDEV" /etc/secure-volume.key
fi
sudo -n cryptsetup luksDump "$LOOPDEV" | head -20

echo "=== STEP 6: open + format fs (idempotent) ==="
if [ ! -e /dev/mapper/secure_srv ]; then
  sudo -n cryptsetup luksOpen "$LOOPDEV" secure_srv --key-file /etc/secure-volume.key
fi
if ! sudo -n blkid /dev/mapper/secure_srv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n mkfs.xfs /dev/mapper/secure_srv
fi
sudo -n blkid /dev/mapper/secure_srv

echo "=== STEP 7: mount point + mount ==="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/secure
if ! mountpoint -q /srv/secure; then
  sudo -n mount /dev/mapper/secure_srv /srv/secure
fi
df -h /srv/secure

echo "=== STEP 8: install boot unlock/mount helper script ==="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/srv-secure-mount.sh >/dev/null <<'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
IMG=/var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
KEY=/etc/secure-volume.key
MAPNAME=secure_srv
MNT=/srv/secure

start() {
  LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$IMG" | cut -d: -f1)
  if [ -z "$LOOPDEV" ]; then
    LOOPDEV=$(losetup -f --show "$IMG")
  fi
  if [ ! -e "/dev/mapper/$MAPNAME" ]; then
    cryptsetup luksOpen "$LOOPDEV" "$MAPNAME" --key-file "$KEY"
  fi
  if ! mountpoint -q "$MNT"; then
    mount "/dev/mapper/$MAPNAME" "$MNT"
  fi
}

stop() {
  if mountpoint -q "$MNT"; then
    umount "$MNT"
  fi
  if [ -e "/dev/mapper/$MAPNAME" ]; then
    cryptsetup luksClose "$MAPNAME"
  fi
  LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$IMG" | cut -d: -f1)
  if [ -n "$LOOPDEV" ]; then
    losetup -d "$LOOPDEV"
  fi
}

case "$1" in
  start) start ;;
  stop) stop ;;
  *) echo "usage: $0 {start|stop}" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
SCRIPT
sudo -n chmod 700 /usr/local/sbin/srv-secure-mount.sh
sudo -n chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/srv-secure-mount.sh

echo "=== STEP 9: install systemd unit ==="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/srv-secure.service >/dev/null <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Unlock and mount encrypted /srv/secure volume
DefaultDependencies=no
After=local-fs-pre.target systemd-udevd.service
Before=local-fs.target umount.target
Conflicts=umount.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/srv-secure-mount.sh start
ExecStop=/usr/local/sbin/srv-secure-mount.sh stop

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
UNIT

sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable srv-secure.service
sudo -n systemctl is-enabled srv-secure.service

echo "=== STEP 10: write a marker file with data on the encrypted volume ==="
echo "secure-data-$(date -u +%s)" | sudo -n tee /srv/secure/marker.txt >/dev/null
sudo -n cat /srv/secure/marker.txt

echo "=== DONE setup ==="
